messages:
Elaine: quick heads-up — Cobalt HSM + IntegrateSI want to launch in the cloud marketplace mid-May. they need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and a KMS/HSM integration option. can we align on scope and cutover timeline? :eyes:
Mateo: sounds good. security first — need FIPS cert, HSM attestation report, and a KMS API option (preferable) + KMIP fallback. also require audit log format for key ops.
Sri: timeline constraints? marketplace submission deadline is usually ~3 weeks before listing. do we aim for May 18 listing? if so we need tech checklist by May 1.
Jordan: IntegrateSI will own SCIM end-to-end but we need to validate attribute mappings (email, username, externalId, groups). recommend a test tenant and a sample mapping doc. I'll set up a tenant.
Elaine: agreed. high-level plan: 1) confirm compliance docs (Mateo) 2) SCIM mapping + test tenant (Jordan) 3) SAML metadata exchange + test SSO (Sri) 4) KMS integration spec & sample calls (me + eng-ml) 5) marketplace listing assets (marketing).
MarketplaceBot: Reminder — marketplace submission cutoff: 1710000000 (placeholder) — upload vendor package and security attestations at least 21 days prior.
Mateo: for KMS integration: propose two modes: a) delegated-keys via our KMS API (recommended), b) external HSM via KMIP with envelope keys. need to confirm which Cobalt supports. also require HSM firmware version.
Jordan: on SCIM: sample endpoints from IntegrateSI: `https://si-partner.test.scim/v2/Users` and `https://si-partner.test.scim/v2/Groups`. we'll test bulk create + patch. suggest script: `curl -u test:token -H 'Content-Type: application/scim+json' -d @users.json $SCIM_USERS`
Sri: SAML notes — exchange metadata URL, cert, and IdP entityID. also test SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. capture SAML assertions mapping for `roles` and `groups`.
Elaine: risk flags: embargo timing w/ partner marketing, legal NDAs for joint announcement, and any gov-cloud restrictions. need legal + marketing sync next Wed.
Jordan: i'll post the SCIM sample mapping doc to the #partner-integration channel today and invite IntegrateSI engineers.
Mateo: i'll pull the attestation template and post required fields. also will ask infra to run HSM attestation checklist.
Elaine: action items: Elaine -> draft checklist by Fri; Mateo -> collect compliance docs by Tue; Jordan -> test tenant + mapping doc by Thu; Sri -> SAML test plan by Thu. if anyone hits blockers ping me or @here in #partnerships. :thumbsup:
